exposure: perinatal death (as predictor for maternal end-organ injury)
cohort: Women diagnosed with eclampsia who delivered at Ayder Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (ACSH) in Tigray, Ethiopia between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Eclampsia prevalence at ACSH was 1.1% and was associated with a 3.3% case-fatality rate and 20.1% perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as an independent predictor of perinatal death (aOR 5.5, 95% CI 2.3-13.3).
cross-section timing: Data collected between 1 January 2017 and 31 December 2021
